entries.value: "MCP server store (SQLite at ~/.base-studio-code/mcp.db) for base-studio-code — a thin MCP-specific shim over the shared bsc-json-store, plus the persona ASSIGNMENT verbs. A server reaches a session because a persona carries it; there is no project or per-pane scoping."

lead: # build.rs parses the committed graph store directly — see crates/graph-materialize/build.rs.

lead: # THE SHARED CRATE ROOT — this crate owns no source file at all. See
# crates/graph-materialize/crate_root.rs; the crate's own docs come from its record.
# The shared verbatim-JSON-per-id store + CLI scaffold — this crate supplies only the MCP-specific
# nouns, the lean `list` projection, and the assign/unassign verbs.
# Shared CLI scaffold: `CmdDoc` for the per-command help catalog + store-path resolution.
# Assignment is a read-modify-write of the PERSONA record, so this crate parses persona JSON.
